terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.section1Content: By accessing and using the 7Care application, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any aspect of these terms, you should not use our application.
terms.section2Content: 7Care is a church management system that allows the registration and tracking of members, small group management, internal communication, and other features related to church administration.
terms.section3Content: To use 7Care, you must create an account by providing accurate and up-to-date information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and for all activities that occur under your account.
terms.section4Content: You agree to use 7Care only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms. You must not use the service to:
terms.section4Item1: Violate any applicable laws or regulations
terms.section4Item2: Infringe the rights of third parties
terms.section4Item3: Transmit illegal, offensive, or harmful content
terms.section4Item4: Attempt to access systems or data without authorization
terms.section5Content: All content on 7Care, including text, graphics, logos, icons, and software, is the property of 7Care or its licensors and is protected by intellectual property laws.
terms.section6Content: 7Care is provided "as is" and "as available". We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free. In no event shall we be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.
terms.section7Content: We may modify these terms at any time. Changes will take effect after the publication of the updated terms in the application. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.
terms.section8Content: These terms shall be governed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Brazil. Any dispute arising from these terms shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of Brazilian courts.
terms.section9Content: If you have questions about these Terms of Use, please contact us through the support available in the application.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Content: We collect information that you provide to us directly, including:
privacy.section1Item4: Communication and interaction information in the application
privacy.section2Content: We use the collected information to:
privacy.section2Item2: Personalize your experience in the application
privacy.section3Content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with:
privacy.section3Item1: Leaders and administrators of your church (as necessary for management)
privacy.section3Item2: Service providers who assist us in operating the application
privacy.section3Item3: Legal authorities when required by law
privacy.section4Content: In compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD), you have the following rights:
privacy.section4Item1: Confirm the existence of data processing
privacy.section4Item3: Correct incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data
privacy.section4Item4: Request anonymization, blocking, or deletion of data
privacy.section5Content: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your information, including encryption, access control, and continuous monitoring. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacy.section6Content: We retain your information for as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations. You may request the deletion of your data at any time, subject to legal retention requirements.
privacy.section7Content: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve the user experience, analyze application usage, and personalize content. You can manage your cookie preferences in your browser settings.
privacy.section8Content: 7Care is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not intentionally collect information from children. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with data, please contact us.
privacy.section9Content: We may update this policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes through the application or by email. We recommend reviewing this policy regularly.
privacy.section10Content: To exercise your rights or clarify questions about this policy, please contact us through the support available in the application or through your church's contact email.
